hooks.command: file="$QODER_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(java|ts|tsx|js|jsx|less|css)$'; then if ! head -1 "$file" | grep -q '^/\*'; then echo "ERROR: File $file is missing the license header. Every new source file must start with the Apache 2.0 license comment (see LICENSE.txt)."; exit 1; fi; fi
file="$QODER_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(java)$'; then cd backend_java && mvn compile -q 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
file="$QODER_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|less|css|md)$'; then cd frontend && npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi
file="$QODER_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then cd frontend && npx eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "$file"; fi
